comment: Read by scripts/db-shards.ts, which splits the database conformance run items across the CI shards.

parts: a suite too long for one shard runs as k items, <path>#i/k, each with SUITE_PART=i/k; the suite registers only the cases inPart gives its part. d06-generated took 5721s across its six parts (median, below), 12 to 18 minutes a part, so it runs in 18; d06-agent took 591s whole, so it runs in 2.

seconds: each run item's time in a hosted shard, the median over the green merge groups of 12 October 2026 (runs 38231936066, 38227417069, 38227415834, 38222181563, 38217832262; the 'moved the database counter by N in Ss' lines), every one of the 1302 items then named. A part of d06-generated weighs an 18th of its six parts' total and d06-agent's a half of its whole, each plus 20 s for the fixture a part builds. Only the balance reads them: an item missing here still runs, weighted at the median. Refresh from a recent run when the shards drift apart.
